as_of: 2026-09-20, orchestrator pass 176 -- both rows still running; these are their committed results, read from their branches
headline: The two scopes that were blocked -- 8.6713 % of the model's gradient mass between them -- both cleared their FORWARD this pass. The pairformer trunk's pair track reads 4.947045e-02 against a reference rebuilt at 0.4.3, UNDER the 5.0e-02 bar and 0.70x the A26 reachable bar; and aux_heads' five heads read EXACTLY 0.000000e+00 once the call site passes the masks it was dropping. Neither scope's gradient is measured yet -- A18 opens the gate, it does not close the question.

the_trunk_of3t_trunk043ref.result: SHIPPED port against a 0.4.3-rebuilt reference on the same captured boundary and weights: pair track 4.947045e-02 masked at crop 64, 4.853716e-02 at N=384. Under the 5.0e-02 per-tensor bar, 0.70x the A26 reachable bar.
the_trunk_of3t_trunk043ref.how_much_was_the_reference: 92.08 % of the previously published 2.793661e-01 was the reference revision, MEASURED directly rather than bounded. My own pass-176 triangle estimate said 85.6 % (THE_REVISION_ARM_RAN.json) -- the right region, but low, and the direct measurement supersedes it.
the_trunk_of3t_trunk043ref.the_orientation_question_is_closed: transpose_bias is the ONLY live difference between the two release trees on this path in float64: 0.5.0 forced onto the 0.4.3 orientation reads EXACTLY 0.0 on both tracks, masked and padded, at both crops. The shipped orientation is correct for of3-p2-155k and of3t-trunkfwd's flag warning is superseded.
the_trunk_of3t_trunk043ref.the_single_track_is_still_ours_and_is_no: 1.065338e-01 against 0.4.3 versus 1.012900e-01 against 0.5.0 -- slightly WORSE against the correct reference, which confirms D99's reading that it is ours and convention-invariant. 74.88 % of it is a 9.22 % magnitude deficit, and a 19-rung depth ladder puts 84 % of it in BLOCKS 45-47, where our distance from upstream's own bf16 steps 10.09x -> 24.15x on a single block. That is a located defect, not a diffuse one.
the_trunk_of3t_trunk043ref.controls: A16 zero model exactly 1.000000e+00 measured; instrument floor exactly 0.0; break control moves the pair reading 10.84x and its angular error 208.6x; the attention-precision machinery is bit-identical when selecting the native policy and worth 3.86e-03 when switched -- which is D93 measured on device, consistent with the 6.070e-03 I measured on CPU.

aux_heads_of3t_auxfind.result: arm P -- what the shipped PairformerLayer computes when handed pair_mask and attn_mask -- against arm R, what upstream computes: 0.000000e+00 on ALL FIVE heads, norm ratio 1.000000, cos 1.000000. Against the same arms the unmasked port reads 3.02e-01 to 5.20e-01, so the scale of what was repaired is not in doubt.
aux_heads_of3t_auxfind.the_repair: threading the two masks into the call site is SUFFICIENT for forward_device. The shared Pairformer needs no new trans_mask and the row explicitly declines to propose one -- a narrower fix than the defect first suggested.
aux_heads_of3t_auxfind.the_control_that_was_REWRITTEN_is_the_be: control 5's first version looked for movement on the scored scope, found none, and would have been INDISTINGUISHABLE from the flag never arriving at all. Rewritten to score where the flag can actually act, it moves the padded rows of z by 7.380796e+02 and of s by 1.391574e+03 while the real block stays at exactly 0.0. An exact zero is only evidence if you have shown the lever was live, and the row caught that itself.
aux_heads_of3t_auxfind.further_controls: control 6 -- masks forced to ones makes the flag a no-op at exactly 0.0, so it acts ONLY through the mask; control 7 -- arm R against the captured 0.4.3 reference is exactly 0.0 on 5 of 5, re-run in-process rather than carried in.

what_this_does_NOT_establish: both results are FORWARDS. A18's rule is that a disagreeing forward invalidates the gradient; an agreeing one merely stops invalidating it. The trunk's 5.8282 % and aux_heads' 2.8431 % still need their GRADIENTS measured against the bars before either can be counted as reproduced, and the trunk's single track (1.065338e-01, 2.13x the bar) still fails -- located in blocks 45-47, but not fixed.
